props.title: CVE-2026-109618 — PHP 8.x
props.message:
Memory corruption RCE, no auth required. Actively exploited per CISA. KEV added 2026-10-26. EPSS 0.9999

Upgrade PHP to ≥8.3.36 / ≥8.4.27 / ≥8.5.12 and restart servers today.

props.title: CVE-2026-109619 — PHP 8.x
props.message:
Stale request-state RCE, no auth required. Actively exploited per CISA. KEV added 2026-10-26. EPSS 0.9999

Upgrade PHP to ≥8.3.36 / ≥8.4.27 / ≥8.5.12.

props.title: CVE-2026-110447 — Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server
props.message:
OS command injection when CODE server is stopped; allows RCE. Actively exploited per CISA. KEV added 2026-10-23. EPSS 0.116

Apply Collabora Online update or disable built-in CODE server now.

props.title: CVE-2026-114625 — Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator
props.message:
On-prem SQL injection reaches privileged internal functions. Confirmed in-the-wild. KEV added 2026-10-23. EPSS 0.010

Schedule upgrade: apply Arista VeloCloud vendor patch.

props.title: GHSA-m4w4-3r8h-jw98 — agno (pip)
props.message:
Arbitrary code execution via eval() on user-controlled field_type in FunctionCall. CVSS 9.8

Schedule upgrade: agno → ≥2.3.24

props.title: GHSA-6hp3-vr39-rqw8 — MONAI (pip)
props.message:
Crafted DICOM input crashes server and silently corrupts inference output. CVSS 9.3

Schedule upgrade: monai → ≥1.6.1

props.title: GHSA-6v38-4h7w-rj9h — authlib (pip)
props.message:
Empty signature passes JWS JSON deserialization — auth bypass. Related: empty HMAC key forgery (CVE-2026-114616). CVSS 9.1 · EPSS 0.004

Schedule upgrade: authlib → ≥1.9.1

props.title: GHSA-965c-763c-88jm — better-auth (npm)
props.message:
OAuth state accepted as Magic Link token — unauthenticated sign-in as any user. CVSS 9.1 · EPSS 0.004

Schedule upgrade: better-auth → ≥1.7.7

props.title: GHSA-h3rc-6mm3-gc2m — vLLM (pip)
props.message:
User-controlled mm_processor_kwargs.code_revision allows RCE. Fix in 0.31.0. CVSS 8.1

Track vllm; upgrade → ≥0.31.0

props.title: GHSA-f897-62hf-6gxq — @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (npm)
props.message:
HTTP transports lack request body and JSON-RPC batch size limits — DoS. Fix in 1.30.1. CVSS 7.5

Track; upgrade @modelcontextprotocol/sdk → ≥1.30.1

props.title: GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q — go-jose (Go)
props.message:
Panic parsing malformed RSA JWKs — DoS. No patched version confirmed. CVSS 7.5

Watch go-jose/v3 and go-jose/v4 for patch; avoid exposing JWKS parsing to untrusted input.
